description: Separate authorization class from risk tier. This proposal does not activate itself or change current R3/R4 behavior.

AUTO_AUTHORIZED.description: Non-trust-root change with complete required evidence; eligible for automatic merge after matrix and independent review.

PREAUTHORIZED_CONDITIONAL.description: R3/R4 engineering change covered by an existing owner authorization record with matching scope and policy version.

OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED.description: Trust-root, credential, workflow-source, external side-effect, or policy-bound change requiring a fresh owner authorization record.

PROHIBITED.description: Operations that would expand the agent trust boundary or self-authorize a policy change.

activationRule: A new policy or trust-root change must be authorized by an existing protected policy and an independent owner authorization record. A PR cannot authorize its own changes.
